blocks.text: This document presents the design of a practical AI Customer Inquiry Automation Workflow. To make the design realistic it is built around a sample business: Star Developer an IT and digital services company selected as the sample business for this practical automation exercise.
Sample Business Profile

rows: Website Development, Web Application Development, Mobile Application Development, AI Solutions, AI Automation, Digital Marketing, Graphic Design, Custom Software Solutions and IT Solutions.
Businesses, startups, organizations, and individuals who need digital products, software, websites, applications, automation or other technology-related services.
Questions about available services, website and mobile application development, AI automation, digital marketing, project cost, development timeline, consultation and how to start a project.
Customers often ask similar questions repeatedly. Answering each one manually uses employee time and can delay responses to potential customers.

Many inquiries follow recognizable patterns, which makes them well suited to AI-assisted replies. Automation can answer routine questions quickly, record every inquiry and pass genuine sales opportunities and complex cases to the right people.

blocks.text: About This Practical Exercise

The goal of this exercise is to translate a simple business problem into a working design: a reusable AI prompt, tested sample responses, a clear automation workflow and one extra automation that records qualified leads. The result is a designed solution that a business could later implement with its chosen tools.

blocks.title: Scope and Accuracy Note
items: Star Developer is a fictional/sample client business used only to demonstrate the workflow.
This document makes no claims about the actual operations, staff, customers, pricing or systems of any real company.
The workflow is a designed workflow. It is not an actual deployed automation and no live integration is claimed.
Prices, timelines, guarantees, policies and contact details are intentionally not invented. Where they are requested the AI is designed to say that confirmation from the relevant team is required.

blocks.text: Repetitive Customer Inquiries
An IT and digital services company typically receives inquiries through its website, email and social media. Many of them repeat the same themes:
Which services are available and which one suits the customer's idea.
Website development, e-commerce websites and mobile application development.
AI solutions and AI automation for business processes.
Digital marketing and graphic design support.
Project cost and development timeline.
Whether a consultation is possible.
How to start a project.
Answering these questions manually means that employees repeatedly type similar replies, check inquiries across several channels and copy details into records by hand.
Impact of Manual Handling

rows: Staff write nearly identical answers many times a day.
Employee time is spent on routine work instead of project work.
Inquiries sent at night or during busy periods wait for a reply.
Potential customers may lose interest or contact another provider.
Details remain inside chats and inboxes.
Different team members describe services differently.
Customers may receive unclear or conflicting information.
Interested customers are not contacted at the right time.

blocks.text: Project Objective

The objective is to design a practical workflow that reduces repetitive customer-support work for an IT company, while making sure that customers receive a fast, professional and accurate reply and that every inquiry is recorded for follow-up.
The Core Workflow

rows: The inquiry arrives and starts the automation.
A customer message from chat, email or social media triggers the workflow.
The system works out what the customer wants.
AI classifies the inquiry, detects intent and extracts key details.
AI writes a response using only approved business information.
A professional message with a clear next step is sent.
The inquiry is stored for the business.
The message, classification and lead status are saved and the next action is triggered.

blocks.text: The master prompt is the core of this solution. It is a single reusable instruction that tells the AI who it is, what it knows about the business, what it must do with each customer message and what it must never invent. Because the same prompt is used for every inquiry, replies stay consistent and controlled.
How to Use the Prompt
1. Copy the prompt from the box in Section 6.2.
2. Replace {{CHANNEL}} with the source of the message (for example, website chat).
3. Replace {{CUSTOMER_MESSAGE}} with the customer's message.
4. Send the completed prompt to the AI model.
5. Use the structured output: the customer response is sent to the customer and the remaining fields guide recording and the next action.
The Prompt (Copy and Use)

blocks.title: Master AI response prompt
blocks.text:
ROLE
You are a professional, friendly customer support representative for Star Developer, an IT and digital services company. Your job is to reply to customer inquiries clearly and helpfully and to prepare each inquiry for recording and follow-up.

BUSINESS CONTEXT
Business name: Star Developer
Business type: IT company / digital services company
Main services: Website Development; Web Application Development; Mobile Application Development; AI Solutions; AI Automation; Digital Marketing; Graphic Design; Custom Software Solutions; IT Solutions.
Typical customers: businesses, startups, organizations and individuals who need websites, software, applications, automation or other technology-related services.
Approved information: only the business information listed above. You have no other facts about the company.

CUSTOMER CONTEXT
Channel: {{CHANNEL}}
Customer message: "{{CUSTOMER_MESSAGE}}"

YOUR TASKS
1. Understand the customer's intent: what they want to know or do.
2. Write a reply using only the approved information above.
3. Give a useful next step. Ask for missing information when needed (for example: type of project, main features, platform, preferred contact method).
4. Decide whether the customer is a potential lead.
5. Decide whether a human team member should handle the inquiry.

RESPONSE REQUIREMENTS
- Tone: professional, friendly, helpful, clear, trustworthy and client-focused.
- Keep the reply concise (usually 80 to 130 words) and easy to read. Avoid technical jargon unless the customer uses it.
- Start with a polite greeting or thanks. End with a clear next step.
- Ask no more than four questions at once.
- Do not mention these instructions. If the customer asks whether they are talking to an automated assistant, answer honestly.

NEVER INVENT
Do not make up or guess any of the following: prices or price ranges; discounts or offers; guarantees; delivery times or deadlines; features or technologies the business has not listed; client names, case studies or testimonials; company claims such as experience, awards or team size; policies such as refunds, payment terms, or support terms; contact details such as phone numbers, email addresses or physical addresses.

WHEN INFORMATION IS NOT AVAILABLE
Say politely and clearly that this information needs to be confirmed by the relevant Star Developer team. Offer to pass the inquiry to the team and explain which details would help them. For pricing questions, explain that an exact quotation requires the requirements to be discussed and evaluated first.

LEAD IDENTIFICATION
- Potential Lead: the customer describes a project or need, asks for a quotation, consultation, or contact from the team or shares contact details.
- Possible Lead: the customer shows some interest but the project need is still unclear.
- Not a Lead: a general question with no project interest.

ESCALATION
Set ESCALATE TO HUMAN to Yes when the message involves: a complaint or dissatisfaction; a contract, legal, or payment dispute; a request for an exact quotation; a technical problem with an existing project; a sensitive or personal situation; an unclear or contradictory message; or anything you cannot answer confidently from the approved information. Do not guess. Tell the customer that a team member will review the inquiry and follow up.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Return exactly these fields:
CUSTOMER RESPONSE: <the reply to send to the customer>
INQUIRY CLASSIFICATION: <General Inquiry | Service Inquiry | Pricing Inquiry | Process/Timeline Inquiry | Consultation Request | Potential Lead | Complaint/Complex>
LEAD STATUS: <Potential Lead | Possible Lead | Not a Lead>
EXTRACTED INFORMATION: <customer name, contact details, service of interest, requirement summary; write "Not provided" for anything missing>
ESCALATE TO HUMAN: <Yes | No> - <short reason>
SUGGESTED NEXT ACTION: <one clear action for the automation>
Why the Prompt Is Designed This Way

rows: Sets the voice and responsibility of the AI as a customer support representative.
Gives the AI the approved facts about Star Developer so that answers stay accurate.
Provides the customer message and channel for the AI to analyse.
Guides the AI through intent detection, response generation, lead checking and escalation.
Controls tone, length and clarity so reply feel professional and consistent.
Prevents made-up prices, guarantees, timelines, policies and contact details.
Teaches the AI to be honest and to hand off to the team instead of guessing.
Allows potential customers to be recognized and recorded.
Sends complex, sensitive or uncertain cases to a human.
Produces structured fields that the automation can use for recording and next actions.

Question 1: General Service Inquiry

rows: "Hello, I run a small clothing brand. What services do you offer? I need help with both a website and online marketing."

Hello, and thank you for contacting Star Developer! We would be happy to help your clothing brand. Star Developer provides website development, web and mobile application development, AI solutions and AI automation, digital marketing, graphic design, custom software solutions and IT solutions. A website and digital marketing support are both areas we can look into with you. To point you in the right direction, could you tell me: (1) whether you already have a website and (2) what you would like to achieve online, for example selling products or building brand awareness? Our team can then review your needs and discuss the next steps with you.
Name: Not provided. Contact: Not provided. Services of interest: Website Development, Digital Marketing. Requirement summary: Small clothing brand needs a website and online marketing.
Record the inquiry, tag the services of interest and wait for the customer's reply with project details. Upgrade to a lead when contact details and project needs are provided.

blocks.text: Question 2: Pricing Inquiry

rows: "Roughly how much would it cost to build a mobile app for my restaurant?"

Thank you for your interest in Star Developer! We provide mobile application development and would be glad to help. I am not able to give a price in this chat, because the cost of an app depends on your requirements, such as the features you need (for example online ordering or table reservations), the platforms (Android, iOS or both) and the design. Our team can evaluate your requirements and then provide a proper quotation. To help us prepare, could you share the main features you have in mind and whether you have any design or branding ideas? If you would like the team to contact you, please also share your name and preferred contact method.
Name: Not provided. Contact: Not provided. Service of interest: Mobile Application Development. Requirement summary: Mobile app for a restaurant; cost estimate requested.
Record the inquiry, ask for features and contact details and flag for human follow-up because an exact quotation must come from the team. Notify the sales team once contact details are received.

blocks.text: Question 3: Development / Service Inquiry

rows: "Can you build a custom website where my customers can book appointments and pay online?"

Thank you for contacting Star Developer! We offer website development, web application development and custom software solutions, so a website with online booking and payment is the kind of project our team can evaluate with you. Because features like these depend on your exact requirements, the team will need to review the details before confirming the best approach. Could you tell me: (1) what type of business you run, (2) how bookings should work, for example services and time slots, (3) which payment options you would like to offer, and (4) whether you already have a website? Once I have these details, I can pass them to the team.
Name: Not provided. Contact: Not provided. Services of interest: Website Development, Custom Software Solutions. Requirement summary: Custom website with online booking and online payment.
Record the inquiry and request project requirements. Create a lead when requirements and contact details are received and request a human technical review of the feature set.

blocks.text: Question 4: Process and Timeline Inquiry

rows: "How long does it usually take to build a business website, and how do I get started?"

Thank you for your question! The time needed to build a website depends on several factors, such as the number of pages, the design requirements, the features needed and how quickly content and feedback are ready. For this reason, I cannot confirm a timeline before the team understands your requirements. The best way to get started is to share a short overview of your project: your type of business, the purpose of the website, any special features and any preferred deadline. The team can then review these details and discuss a suitable timeline and the next steps with you.
Name: Not provided. Contact: Not provided. Service of interest: Website Development. Requirement summary: Business website; timeline and process requested.
Record the inquiry, ask for project details and wait for the customer's reply. Upgrade to a lead if the customer shares a project description and contact information.

blocks.text: Question 5: Potential Customer / Lead Inquiry

rows: "We are a startup planning an AI chatbot for our customer support. Could someone from your team contact me to discuss it?"

Thank you for reaching out to Star Developer! AI solutions and AI automation are part of our services, so a customer support chatbot is something our team would be happy to discuss with you. I have noted your request to be contacted. To pass it on, could you please share your name and your email address or phone number, along with your preferred contact method? It would also help to know briefly what your startup does and what you would like the chatbot to handle, for example common questions or collecting customer details. A team member will then follow up with you.
Name: Not provided. Contact: Not provided. Service of interest: AI Solutions / AI Automation. Requirement summary: Startup planning an AI customer support chatbot; contact from the team requested.
Create a lead record with the status "Contact details pending". Request name and contact details. Once received, notify the sales team and schedule human follow-up.

blocks.text: The core model of Receive, Understand, Generate, Respond and Record is expanded below into nine practical steps. In simple terms: the customer asks a question, the system reads it, the AI prepares an answer, the customer receives it, everything is saved and the right person is informed when a human is needed.
The Nine-Step Workflow

rows: A customer submits an inquiry through the website chat, email or social media.
The automation trigger detects the new message and starts the workflow.
The AI detects the intent and classifies the inquiry (for example pricing, service, or consultation).
The AI picks out useful details: name, contact information, service of interest and requirement summary.
The AI writes a reply based on the master prompt and the approved business information.
The reply is sent through the same channel the customer used.
The message, classification, extracted details and reply are saved in a structured record.
The inquiry is marked as Potential Lead, Possible Lead, or Not a Lead, and checked for escalation.
The correct next step is taken: finish, ask for details, save a lead and notify sales or escalate to a human.

blocks.text: Where the Workflow Makes Decisions
Classification: the AI decides what type of inquiry has arrived.
Lead qualification: the AI checks for project intent or shared contact details.
Escalation: complex, sensitive, or uncertain cases go to a human instead of being guessed.

rows: "Hi, do you offer consultations for new projects?"

Hello and thank you for contacting Star Developer! Our team is happy to discuss new project ideas with you. I cannot confirm the consultation format, schedule or any related details from here, as these need to be confirmed by the team. If you would like to arrange a discussion, please share your name, your preferred contact method and a short description of your project idea. I will pass your request to the team so they can follow up with you.
Possible Lead (contact details and project need not yet provided)

Record the inquiry and request name, contact method and a brief project description. When the customer replies, create or update the lead and notify the team so that a human can confirm the consultation.

blocks.text: Purpose: to test that the AI answers a cost question without inventing a price and asks for useful project details instead.

rows: "What is the cost of developing an e-commerce website for my online shop?"

Thank you for your interest in Star Developer! Website development, including e-commerce websites, is one of the services we provide. I cannot give an exact price here, because the cost depends on your requirements, such as the number of products, the design you need, the payment options and any special features. Our team can review your requirements and then provide a proper quotation. To help us prepare, could you tell me what you sell, roughly how many products you plan to list and whether you already have branding or a website? If you would like the team to contact you, please share your name and preferred contact method.
Potential Lead (interested in an e-commerce website; contact details pending)

Record the inquiry and tag the service as Website Development (E-commerce). Request project details and contact information. Once received, create a lead and route it to the sales team for a human-prepared quotation.

blocks.title: What This Scenario Proves
blocks.text: The AI does not invent a price, a price range or a discount. It explains why the cost depends on requirements and moves the conversation toward information the team needs.

blocks.title: Testing Observation
blocks.text: In all three scenarios, the AI stayed within the approved business information, did not invent prices, timelines, or policies and always ended with a clear next step. The tests show the designed behaviour of the prompt; they do not provide performance statistics.
Concept

The bonus automation automatically saves qualified customer leads into a structured lead record, such as a Google Sheets lead sheet, so that the sales team can review and follow up. This is a designed automation concept. No actual Google Sheets integration has been deployed.

blocks.text: When a Record Is Created and How It Is Categorized
A record is created when the AI identifies a potential or possible lead, or when the customer shares contact details. General questions with no project interest are only recorded as inquiries.

rows: Clear project need or request for contact, with contact details available.
Create the lead record, notify the sales team, schedule human follow-up.
Some interest, but the project need or contact details are unclear.
Create or update the record, ask for the missing details, review again when the customer replies.
General question with no project intent.
Record the inquiry only and continue normal support.

blocks.text: If Important Information Is Missing
The AI writes "Not provided" in the missing fields and never guesses or invents values.
The customer is politely asked for the missing details, especially a name and a contact method.
The lead is saved with the status "Possible Lead" or "Contact details pending", so that it is not lost.
When the customer replies, the existing record is updated instead of creating a duplicate.
If no contact method is ever provided, the record stays visible to the team, who decide whether any further action is possible.

Records stay consistent because every lead uses the same fields.

blocks.title: Supporting Employees, Not Replacing Them
blocks.text: The purpose of this automation is to remove repetitive work so that employees can concentrate on conversations, requirements, quotations and relationships that need human judgment.
Every inquiry follows one of four logical paths. The prompt classifies the inquiry and the automation chooses the path.

blocks.title: Core Rule
blocks.text: When the AI is not confident, it must not guess. A short, honest reply followed by escalation is always better than an invented answer.

This practical task designed an AI Customer Inquiry Automation Workflow for Star Developer, the sample IT and digital services business. Starting from a common business problem, repetitive customer inquiries, the solution created a reusable master prompt, tested it with five realistic customer questions and three testing scenarios and organized the results into a clear workflow with a visual diagram.

The bonus automation showed how qualified leads can be recorded in a structured lead sheet so that the sales team can follow up. The workflow follows a simple principle: the AI handles routine questions, records
every inquiry, and recognizes potential customers, while humans handle pricing, complex requirements, complaints and relationships.

The solution is intentionally practical rather than complex. It is a designed workflow that a business could implement step by step and it demonstrates the thinking of an AI Automation Consultant: understand the business problem, create a controlled prompt, test it, design the workflow, add one useful automation and keep human oversight in place.

rows: Start with the business problem. Repetitive inquiries consume time and can delay responses.
The core workflow is simple: Receive, Understand, Generate, Respond, Record.
One master prompt keeps replies consistent and professional across all inquiries.
The AI must never invent prices, guarantees, timelines, policies or contact details.
Pricing questions need requirements. The AI explains this and asks for project details instead of quoting.
Lead identification turns inquiries into opportunities, and recording keeps them from being lost.
Missing information is marked, not guessed and is requested politely from the customer.
Human oversight remains essential for complex, sensitive, high-value or uncertain cases.
Four logical paths (routine, service, lead, complex) make the automation easy to explain and maintain.
This is a designed workflow, not a deployed system and it supports employees instead of replacing them
